purpose: Expose what is already evidenced, what is only a candidate, and what remains blocked before the U1 production-intent BOM can be created.

status_definitions.LEGACY_REFERENCE: Exists in B1/Faz2/Faz3 and may be used for comparison; not automatically valid for U1.
status_definitions.CANDIDATE: Exact family or MPN has source-backed evidence but is not selected.
status_definitions.REVALIDATE: Function is likely reusable but rating/implementation must be re-proven against G1/G2.
status_definitions.BLOCKED_BY_G1: Cannot be selected until the system electrical envelope is frozen.
status_definitions.OPEN: No production-intent part may be selected yet.
status_definitions.REPLACE_IF_REQUIRED: Legacy implementation has a known issue or may be superseded after architecture closure.

items.blocker: 100 V class cannot be accepted until G1 transient ceiling and derating policy close.
Requires common G1 current/PWM/temperature/transient envelope and package/cooling trade.
Requires common G1 current/PWM/temperature/transient envelope and package/cooling trade.
Driver voltage domain and gate-drive current must close against final VBUS transient, MOSFET Qg and PWM.
120 V bootstrap absolute maximum does not remove the 100 V HS operating ceiling; not suitable evidence for >100 V normal switch-node operation.
Three half-bridge channels, external current-sense/protection, slower propagation timing and fresh dead-time/FOC review would be required.
Requires isolated/local output bias supplies plus new creepage, CMTI, propagation, cost and PCB-area architecture.
Final MCU trade requires PWM/ADC timing, hardware trip, FOC execution and interface closure.
Exact orderable MPN/package is intentionally not frozen before control-platform trade.
100 V input-domain compatibility depends on final transient ceiling and protection architecture.
Maximum 100 mA output class is suitable only for low-power housekeeping unless the final load budget proves otherwise.
Controller requires external MOSFET/inductor/current-sense and a complete converter design; output-current capability is design-dependent.
Final range, error, bandwidth, package, output sequencing and powered/unpowered bench evidence remain open.
B1 rail-referenced implementation can back-power the analog/control rail and is not a default KEEP.
0.5 mOhm value, pulse rating and 5 W class cannot be accepted until phase RMS/peak current and PWM windows are frozen.
Exact capacitance, voltage, ESR, ripple current, lifetime and transient energy requirement depend on G1.
Effective capacitance under bias and final voltage/transient class remain open.
Cbus, VBUS, allowable inrush, BMS/contact architecture and duty cycle are not frozen.
Regen/BMS-disconnect energy and allowable transient ceiling are not frozen.
Continuous/peak pack and ESC current plus fault-clearing coordination are open.
Final voltage/current, harness gauge, temperature rise, mechanical and environmental requirements are open.
Flight-controller protocol, bus topology, EMC, protection and connector requirements are not frozen.

production_bom_release_rule: No item may be promoted to SELECTED_FOR_U1_PRODUCTION until its parent G1/G2 requirement is closed, exact orderable MPN/footprint is verified, derating evidence exists, and the schematic implementation is reviewed.
anti_hallucination_rule: null/Open fields remain null/Open. Legacy quantities or ratings are references only and must not be copied into U1 production BOM without requirement-backed requalification.
